task: Active-set-frozen (semismooth) Newton for K=3 CRRA REE strict contour-Phi PR equilibrium, G=11 grid, 200-dec flint (h=0, no mask smoothing).

warm_start.reason: lowest strict ||Phi-P||inf among all available checkpoints
warm_start.note: Spec anticipated a warm start near ||Phi-P||inf approx 0.066 (anderson). No saved checkpoint is near 0.066: anderson/P.npy evaluates to 0.2183 (its run.json intermediate 0.066/0.121 figures do not correspond to the saved P.npy). All available PR checkpoints sit at ||Phi-P||inf approx 0.208-0.218, ||.||2 approx 0.44-0.59.

feasibility_gate.comment: Freezing the contour-crossing decisions reproduces strict Phi(P) EXACTLY (0.0) at the warm start. The freeze is correct; phi_frozen is a smooth function of P with the recorded branch decisions replayed.

frozen_newton_run.method: Levenberg-Marquardt on F(P)=phi_frozen(P)-P=0; dense 729x729 FD Jacobian (eps=1e-7, parallel over columns, ~30 min/build), reused as chord; ||F||2 acceptance with adaptive lambda.

as_iter_1.outcome: LM stalled after 4 steps: lambda exploded to 1.6e10, no further descent. Frozen ||F||2 reduced only ~5% (0.567->0.539) before the chord Jacobian became useless.

frozen_newton_run.diverging: Evaluating STRICT Phi at the frozen LM solution gives ||Phi-P||inf=0.503 -- WORSE than the 0.208 start. The frozen solve moved P into a region where the active set flipped in 281 of 729 cells, so the result is NOT a strict fixed point. Active-set iteration 2 started from this worse point (diverging), and was stopped.

decisive_diagnostic_active_set_sensitivi.description: Active-set changes and STRICT residual along the frozen-Newton direction from the L2 warm start, as a function of step size alpha (Newton ||delta||inf = 13.78).
decisive_diagnostic_active_set_sensitivi.interpretation: The frozen-Newton direction is HUGE (||delta||inf=13.78, prices live in [0,1]) because J^{-1} amplifies the 0.2 residual ~470x (smin=0.002). Any step large enough to change the strict residual flips hundreds of cells' crossing topology (313 cells even at alpha=0.1). At step sizes small enough to preserve the active set (alpha<=1e-4), the STRICT residual is PINNED at 0.20777 -- the frozen Newton direction yields ZERO reduction in the true strict residual within the validity region of the frozen active set. There is no descent available inside the current active-set cell.

persistent_kink_cells.description: Crossings that flip even at alpha->0 (1e-6). These are degenerate (dp*dn)<=0 tie-breaks at exact grid-node crossings.
persistent_kink_cells.note: These 3 cells are already AT their fixed point (residual ~1e-17 to 1e-20); the flips are harmless node-tie ambiguities and do NOT hold the ||.||inf. The 0.208 inf-norm is held by BULK cells: (3,5,5)=0.2078, (8,3,5)=0.172, (7,3,5)=0.155, (6,4,5)=0.154, (4,5,5)=0.142, ... -- a broad set, not a localized kink.

ANSWER.does_a_high_precision_strict_equilibrium: NOT reachable by active-set-frozen Newton from any available checkpoint.
ANSWER.is_the_0.06_floor_an_irreducible_kink: The premise does not hold on the available data. (a) No checkpoint is at ~0.06; the best is ||Phi-P||inf=0.2078 (L2). (b) The obstruction is NOT a few stiff kinked cells -- the residual is spread across hundreds of bulk cells (||.||2=0.567). (c) The frozen Jacobian is well-conditioned (cond=1417), so the frozen system IS smooth and solvable; but the warm starts are so far from the equilibrium that the Newton step (||delta||inf=13.8) overshoots wildly and crosses thousands of contour-topology boundaries. (d) Within the active-set validity region (step small enough to keep crossings fixed), the frozen-Newton direction gives exactly zero strict-residual reduction (pinned at 0.20777). The active set is pervasively unstable: any residual-reducing step flips 313+ cells. This is a globally non-smooth landscape, not a localized irreducible kink at 0.06.

highest_precision_achieved.achieved_at: L2 warm start (frozen-Newton could not improve it)

ANSWER.d_FR_definition: RMS distance of interior P from P_FR = sigmoid(tau_F*(u1+u2+u3)), tau_F=2.
ANSWER.active_set_stabilized_or_cycled: Neither converged to a clean equilibrium nor settled into a 2-cycle: the active-set iteration DIVERGES (strict residual rises 0.208->0.503 after the first frozen solve, with 281 cells flipping). The frozen solution is not a strict fixed point.

counts.wall_clock: first build 36.6 min (serial-bug rerun), second build 29.5 min (parallel), plus diagnostics

stiff_cells_note: Top-10 cells holding the bulk residual at the L2 warm start (these are NOT kink ties; they are simply far from the strict fixed point).
P_star_npy: L2 warm start (the lowest-residual strict point found; frozen Newton produced no improvement).
